home-briefing.title: Today's OLA Briefing
home-briefing.userSummary: This section gives you a short briefing on the weather and everyday safety information for your selected area.
details: The briefing on this screen is updated when the lookup is complete.
Select View details to open the full briefing.
home-briefing.suggestedQuestion: Ask what you should check first in today's briefing.

sourceComments.summary: 오늘의 올라 브리핑 카드 목적과 배치
실제 데이터 기반 브리핑 생성 흐름

home-briefing.fallback: You can check today's everyday safety briefing in this section.

life-index.title: Today's Living Conditions
life-index.userSummary: This section brings together safety, weather, air quality, fire and disaster risks, and emergency room congestion.
details: Values marked as loading are updated when each lookup is complete.
Select Safe directions to continue to the everyday safety page.
life-index.suggestedQuestion: Ask which of the current living condition indicators deserves attention.
life-index.fallback: You can check today's weather and nearby everyday safety information in this section.

home-safety-map.title: Safety and Emergency Facilities Map
home-safety-map.userSummary: Use the facility-type buttons to change what appears on the map and check the locations and distances provided on this screen.
details: You can select late-night pharmacies, AEDs, emergency bells and CCTV, safe routes home, or police stations.
In an emergency, prioritize an emergency call and instructions at the scene over map information.
home-safety-map.suggestedQuestion: Ask how to find the facility you need on the map.

sourceComments.summary: 안심 관제 핵심 모듈의 지도 영역

home-safety-map.fallback: You can browse nearby safety and emergency facilities by type in this section.

community-talk.title: Live Community Talk
community-talk.userSummary: This section lets you share nearby safety updates or everyday stories and read your neighbors' latest posts.
details: New posts are shown for your currently selected location.
Please avoid including personal information or your exact home address in a post.
community-talk.suggestedQuestion: Ask how to write a community post safely.

sourceComments.summary: 새 글을 최신 피드에 표시하는 동작

community-talk.fallback: You can read the latest stories from your neighborhood in this section.

safety-location.title: Everyday Safety Search Settings
safety-location.userSummary: Choose an area and search radius, then refresh to recalculate the safety information on this page using the same settings.
details: Select the province or metropolitan city first, followed by the city, county, or district.
The radius applies to information that depends on distance, such as nearby shelters.
safety-location.suggestedQuestion: Choose the area and radius you want, then select Refresh.
safety-location.fallback: You can set the area and radius for the everyday safety search in this section.

emergency-location.title: Emergency Facility Search Settings
emergency-location.userSummary: Choose an area and radius, then refresh to search again for nearby emergency rooms, AEDs, and hospitals using the same settings.
details: Displayed facility information may differ from current operations, so please confirm before visiting.
In an urgent situation, call 119 before searching.
emergency-location.suggestedQuestion: Choose the area and radius you want to search, then select Refresh.

sourceComments.summary: 선택 지역과 반경 기준 시설 조회

emergency-location.fallback: You can set the area and radius for the emergency facility search in this section.

disaster-location.title: Disaster Information Search Settings
disaster-location.userSummary: Choose an area and radius, then refresh to check the weather, advisories, and nearby shelters again using the same settings.
details: Advisories and forecasts can change, so check the reference time shown on the screen.
During an actual disaster, prioritize emergency alerts and the latest guidance from authorities.
disaster-location.suggestedQuestion: Choose the area and radius you want to check, then select Refresh.
disaster-location.fallback: You can set the area and radius for the disaster information search in this section.

weather-coordinate.title: Live Weather Coordinates
weather-coordinate.userSummary: This box explains the displayed area, weather-grid coordinates, and current forecast values.
weather-coordinate.dynamicSummary: For {{region}}, the weather coordinates are latitude {{lat}} and longitude {{lng}}, with KMA grid {{grid}}. The reference time is {{basis}}; the current temperature is {{temp}}, today's low is {{tmn}}, and today's high is {{tmx}}.
details: nx and ny are the grid coordinates used for Korea Meteorological Administration short-range forecasts.
weather-coordinate.fallback: You can review the live weather coordinates and temperatures shown on this screen.

safety-overall.title: Overall Safety
safety-overall.userSummary: This card combines several safety indicators for the selected area into a reference score and rating.
details: The displayed values are updated for the selected area when the lookup is complete.
The score is a reference for comparison. Please also check conditions at the scene and official guidance.
safety-overall.suggestedQuestion: Review the score and rating together.
safety-overall.fallback: You can check the selected area's overall safety rating on this card.

safety-analysis.title: AI Recommended Actions
safety-analysis.userSummary: This section suggests a few quick actions worth taking based on the current area's safety indicators.
details: If no data is available, only general guidance is shown without making assumptions.
In an urgent or dangerous situation, prioritize 112, 119, and official guidance over these suggestions.
safety-analysis.suggestedQuestion: Start by reading the recommended actions currently displayed.
safety-analysis.fallback: You can view AI-recommended actions for the current area in this section.

safety-crime-trend.title: Crime Trend by Type
safety-crime-trend.userSummary: A reference chart showing trends across 6 crime types: violent, theft, assault, intellectual, traffic, and other.
details: This is illustrative sample data based on police statistics (as of 2024.12.31) total counts, not actual monthly statistics.
Check official National Police Agency statistics for accurate monthly figures.
safety-crime-trend.suggestedQuestion: Check the data interpretation note below the chart.
safety-crime-trend.fallback: This card is a chart made from reference sample data.

safety-crime.title: Risk Index Top 5
safety-crime.userSummary: This section uses public crime statistics to rank areas with the highest relative risk index within the same province or metropolitan city.
details: Check the reference date and coverage of the statistics.
A relative index does not determine any individual's actual level of risk.
safety-crime.suggestedQuestion: Compare the ranking only among areas using the same reference scope.
safety-crime.fallback: You can compare risk index rankings by area in this section.

safety-shelters.title: Nearby Shelters
safety-shelters.userSummary: This section shows the number and list of civil defense shelters near the selected area.
details: It is helpful to check facility names and locations in advance.
During a disaster, prioritize on-site controls and emergency alert instructions.
safety-shelters.suggestedQuestion: Check the location of a nearby shelter in advance.
safety-shelters.fallback: You can check nearby shelters in this section.

emergency-er.title: Live Emergency Room Status
emergency-er.userSummary: This section helps you quickly check nearby emergency room locations and reference bed availability.
details: Displayed congestion may differ from current conditions, so calling before visiting is recommended.
Call 119 immediately for severe symptoms or any problem with consciousness or breathing.
emergency-er.suggestedQuestion: Check the nearest emergency room together with its displayed status.
emergency-er.fallback: You can check nearby emergency room information in this section.

emergency-aed.title: Nearby AEDs
emergency-aed.userSummary: This card shows automated external defibrillator installation locations near the current area.
details: If you suspect cardiac arrest, call 119 first and follow the operator's instructions.
Confirm the AED's location and current hours of access at the site.
emergency-aed.suggestedQuestion: Check the location of a nearby AED in advance.
emergency-aed.fallback: You can check nearby AED installation locations on this card.

emergency-hospitals.title: Hospital Search
emergency-hospitals.userSummary: This section lets you search for nearby medical facilities by area and hospital name.
details: The results show each hospital's name and location.
Confirm opening hours and available services with the facility before visiting.
emergency-hospitals.suggestedQuestion: Use the hospital name field to narrow the results.
emergency-hospitals.fallback: You can search for nearby hospitals in this section.

emergency-guides.title: Action Guides by Disaster Type
emergency-guides.userSummary: This section shows basic action guides by disaster type, grouped into natural, social, daily-life safety, and preparedness tabs.
details: Pick a tab above and tap an icon to see the guide for that situation.
If the scene is dangerous or the condition is urgent, call 119 before reading the guide.
emergency-guides.suggestedQuestion: Tap the disaster type you want to check right now.
emergency-guides.fallback: You can review basic action guides by disaster type in this section.

disaster-weather.title: Today's Weather
disaster-weather.userSummary: This card shows the short-term forecast for the current area by time period.
details: Check the displayed temperature and sky conditions before going out.
Forecasts may change, so check the reference time as well.
disaster-weather.suggestedQuestion: Review the forecast reference time and changes by time period together.
disaster-weather.fallback: You can check today's short-term forecast on this card.

disaster-warnings.title: Disaster Weather Advisories
disaster-warnings.userSummary: This section shows current advisories and affected areas provided by the Korea Meteorological Administration.
details: When an advisory appears, check its type and affected area.
For evacuation or travel decisions, prioritize emergency alerts and the latest guidance from authorities.
disaster-warnings.suggestedQuestion: Check whether any advisory is currently in effect.
disaster-warnings.fallback: You can check current disaster weather advisories in this section.

disaster-guides.title: Disaster Response Guides
disaster-guides.userSummary: This section explains basic preparation and evacuation actions for each type of disaster.
details: Open the item that matches the situation and review the steps in order.
During an actual disaster, prioritize on-site controls and official disaster guidance.
disaster-guides.suggestedQuestion: Open the response guide for the type of disaster you need.
disaster-guides.fallback: You can review basic response guidance by disaster type in this section.

disaster-shelters.title: Disaster Shelters
disaster-shelters.userSummary: This section shows civil defense shelters and their locations near the current area.
details: Check a nearby facility in advance.
During an evacuation, follow emergency alerts and instructions at the scene.
disaster-shelters.suggestedQuestion: Check the location of a nearby shelter.
disaster-shelters.fallback: You can check nearby shelters in this section.
